title: Google Maps API Configuration and Distance Search Radius

sections.heading: Google Maps Integration
sections.content:
Brilliant Directories uses Google Maps API for geocoding, radius-based distance searches, and interactive map displays. To enable Google Maps:
1. Navigate to Settings > General Settings > Integrations tab.
2. In the Google Maps API Key field, enter your valid Google Cloud Maps JavaScript API key.
3. Enable Geocoding API and Places API in your Google Cloud Console.

sections.heading: Radius and Zip Code Search
sections.content: Users can search directory listings by distance (miles or kilometers) and zip code. Under My Members > Search Results, you can configure the default search radius options (e.g. 5, 10, 25, 50, 100 miles) and enable auto-detect user location.

procedural_steps: Enable Maps JavaScript, Geocoding, and Places APIs in Google Console

full_text:
Google Maps Integration
Brilliant Directories uses Google Maps API for geocoding, radius-based distance searches, and interactive map displays. To enable Google Maps:
1. Navigate to Settings > General Settings > Integrations tab.
2. In the Google Maps API Key field, enter your valid Google Cloud Maps JavaScript API key.
3. Enable Geocoding API and Places API in your Google Cloud Console.

Radius and Zip Code Search
Users can search directory listings by distance (miles or kilometers) and zip code. Under My Members > Search Results, you can configure the default search radius options (e.g. 5, 10, 25, 50, 100 miles) and enable auto-detect user location.
